application_overview.name: Simple Calculator
application_overview.description: A web-based arithmetic calculator with Add, Subtract, Multiply, and Divide operations built with Streamlit
application_overview.deployment: Streamlit dev server (Tornado) on localhost:8501 via WebSocket

dependencies.name: streamlit
dependencies.usage: All UI rendering, form handling, widget creation

ui_components: st.columns - two-column layout for number inputs
st.error - division by zero error display

items: Zero unit test coverage - all logic embedded in UI flow
No function/class decomposition - calculation logic is not callable
Float precision uses IEEE 754 not decimal.Decimal
No session state - no calculation history
No deployment configuration (no Dockerfile, no CI/CD)

issues.description: No unit tests exist for any code path
issues.recommendation: Extract calculate() function and add pytest test suite

issues.description: Business logic tightly coupled to UI presentation layer
issues.recommendation: Separate calculation engine from Streamlit UI layer

issues.description: IEEE 754 float arithmetic produces silent precision errors (e.g., 0.1+0.2 != 0.3)
README documents only 4 of 18 identifiable code features
issues.recommendation: Rewrite README with features, prerequisites, usage examples, troubleshooting

issues.description: No type annotations on any variables or function signatures
issues.recommendation: Add Python type hints, configure mypy for static analysis

issues.description: No calculation history - each result is ephemeral
issues.recommendation: Implement st.session_state to maintain session history

strengths: Correct division-by-zero handling with st.error() + st.stop()
Efficient st.form batching prevents per-keystroke re-runs
Minimal attack surface - no API calls, no file I/O, no database
Clean two-column layout with computation details expander

overall_health.verdict: Clean, well-written, functionally correct micro-application. Lacks tests, documentation, and structural foundations for safe evolution.
